about: Measured observations for the throughput-memory frontier page (benchmarks/frontier.md). Each series is one machine, one workload, one measurement level and one run or build: never plot points from two series on one line. table_mb is computed, not measured: live full blocks x 900,000 rows x 4 bytes (the T-vector). peak_rss_mb and cpu_s are measured where given, else null. Models and hypothetical formats never appear here.

series.workload: the bench corpus's decoded bytes (209,700,196) recompressed with lbzip2 -9: about 233 blocks of 900 kB
series.level: full decoder (file to hashed output, every CRC checked)
series.source: docs/journal/2026-10-28-workstation-scaling.md, section 9 (run blocks-20261028T015837Z), MB/s medians of 6 interleaved rounds

series.workload: the bench corpus (sha256 82f65ace...): 431 blocks, 209.7 MB decoded
series.level: MTF stage + T-vector build + walk (research harness, not the decoder: no scanner, RLE1, CRC or joining)
series.representation: T-vector, 32 bits a row; cooperative arms share one table among a block's k cores
series.placement: every thread pinned to its own physical core
series.source: docs/journal/2026-10-28-cooperative-inversion.md, section 17.4 (run coop-made-20261029T163333Z), MB/s medians of 20 paired rounds
